summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a routine Form 6-K under cover of its ongoing buyback program, reporting treasury share purchases executed on Euronext Milan from 24-28 August 2026. In the week, Eni bought 3,236,870 shares at a weighted average price of €23.1705 for total consideration of ~€75 million. Since program start on 8 May 2026, Eni purchased 63,026,797 shares (2.08% of capital) for ~€1.415 billion, holding 4.95% as of report date. This is a routine issuer buyback disclosure.
